maya: heads-up — nightly eval just flagged a regression on the instructional decomposition cohort (instr_long_decomp_v2). model=int8_v2, delta ROUGE-L ~ -18%. lots of truncated/hallucinated steps in a few examples.

eval-bot: alert: https://evals.internal/redwood/alerts/2412345678 — failed cohorts: instr_long_decomp_v2 (severity: elevated), promptsets: long-instrs, avg_confidence down 0.22.

alex: ack, grabbing latest artifacts and diffs. will try the local reproducer.

tori: FYI we rolled quant-kernel change last night (commit d3f9a2) and a tokenizer patch (commit a7bc11) in the same window — possible interaction.

sam: nightly infra ran with batch_size=32 and kv_cache_enabled=true. I can spin another run with smaller batch + pinned kernels.

irene: initial severity recommendation? maya: P2 for customer impact; treat as P1 for nightly-eval signal until we know cause. ops/docs needed if we escalate. :warning:

alex: repro command I'm running now:
```
./tools/repro_run --model int8_v2 --promptset instr_long_decomp_v2 --seed 42 --kv-cache off --batch 1 --max-tokens 512
```

alex: quick sample from local repro:
```
> PROMPT: "Break down how to migrate a db with zero downtime..."
> GEN: "Step 1: Prepare schema..."
> GEN: ""  <-- generation stops after step 1, then returns unrelated text in subsequent runs
> LOG: truncated_generation_count=7, avg_gen_len=42, tokenizer_warn=split_mismatch
```

tori: can you try toggling kv-cache and also run against float16 baseline? if behavior disappears on fp16 it's likely quant kernel regression. also try checkout of previous kernel commit (git checkout d3f9a2~1) to confirm.

alex: will try fp16 + old kernel next.

sam: I kicked off an infra rerun with pinned kernels and batch_size=4 (run id: nightly-rerun-2412345800). linking logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/runs/nightly-rerun-2412345800

irene: I'll draft a short incident note for product/pm in case customer investigations need heads-up.

maya: owners/next steps: alex = reproduce + collect 10 failing prompts/examples, tori = kernel + tokenizer bisect, sam = rerun nightly pinned + surface perf traces (latency/token), irene = write brief for PMs. meetback in 1h or sooner if P1 escalates.

- reproduce minimal failing example locally (alex)
- run fp16 baseline (alex)
- run with kv_cache disabled/enabled (alex/tori)
- bisect quant kernel commit (tori)
- rerun nightly with pinned kernel + smaller batch (sam)
